receipts.reason: mypy 2.4.1 with PyQt6 6.12.1's stubs finds two errors at 7816159, the same on linux, win32 and darwin: chatmon/layer.py:824: error: Need type annotation for "app"  [var-annotated], and chatmon/layer.py:917: the same. Both lines are app = QGuiApplication.instance(), new in PR #22's KWin and Hyprland fixes (6f7dd3f). 6.12.1's stubs type the static instance() as returning Self, the case CONTRIBUTING.md's second workaround covers (a value from a static constructor is given its type), and these lines don't have it. CI is green because its types jobs lock 6.11's stubs. Next: the coordinator gives app its type at chatmon/layer.py:824 and :917 (app: QCoreApplication | None = QGuiApplication.instance()), product code, not this round's to change; then mypy with 6.12.1's stubs runs again.
